page.overview:
Who is Tessa Lim?

Tessa Lim was a character in Death on the Titan.

Tessa Lim was an engineer on the Sand Titan. She had a combative relationship with Chief Jarrick Thorne, whom she found incompetent. Thorne died under mysterious circumstances and Tessa was questioned. When asked about the involvement of Riko Marr, she replied that she never told him to steal anything but knew that Thorne had been receiving encrypted messages of the down-low. She admitted that she may have given him the idea to steal the message after seeing him with an injured face. She suggested that Lena Orlov be investigated, suggesting that something was going on between her and Thorne, reacting with disgust when asked if she had such a relationship with Thorne. She suggested that Orlov could only have known known that Marr had been in Thorne's quarters on the night that he was killed if she had been there herself. She then wondered where Jeb Dolan had been on the night, since he had not been present when Marr entered the shigawire hut.
